body: As I realized the gravity of their missing meetings, my heart raced with fear for their well-being. My mind replayed our conversations, each attempt to reach out feeling like a futile gesture. The urge to confront grew stronger—my voice threatening to rise as I saw their disheartened faces. But then came another thought: safety was paramount, and staying clear of danger would be wise. So instead, I took deep breaths, gathered my thoughts, and made a decision:
